business_goals: Prioritize cost savings while maintaining high availability for production workloads and strong security posture.

recommendations.title: ALB Not Using HTTPS Listener
recommendations.description: Application Load Balancer prod-alb only has an HTTP listener on port 80. Traffic is not encrypted in transit.
trade_offs: Review impact on availability and performance before applying.
Enforcing encryption or HTTPS may require certificate management and minor application changes.
recommendations.business_goal_alignment: Directly addresses security concerns that align with the stated business goals.

remediations.title: Add HTTPS listener on ALB
remediations.content:
1. Open EC2 → Load Balancers → select prod-alb
2. Listeners tab → Add listener
3. Protocol: HTTPS, Port: 443
4. Select an ACM certificate
5. Forward to the existing target group
6. (Optional) Redirect HTTP:80 → HTTPS:443

recommendations.title: Underutilized Amazon EC2 Instances
recommendations.description: Instance i-0abc123def456 (m5.2xlarge) has average CPU < 5% and network I/O < 5 MB/s over the last 14 days.
trade_offs: Review impact on availability and performance before applying.
Right-sizing may reduce headroom for traffic spikes.
recommendations.business_goal_alignment: Directly addresses cost concerns that align with the stated business goals.

remediations.title: Inspect metrics then right-size or stop
remediations.content:
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics ...
aws ec2 stop-instances --instance-ids i-0abc123def456
